newsitem.title: INDIA: CRICKET-MONGIA (56) AND GANGULY (52) STRENGTHEN INDIA.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-MONGIA (56) AND GANGULY (52) STRENGTHEN INDIA.

text.p: hit unbeaten half-centuries as India reached 122 for one wicket
at lunch in reply to Australia's 182 on the second day of their
The two had put on 109 runs at lunch as India, overnight 57
Left-hander Ganguly made the most of a stumping chance he
survived off legspinner Peter McIntyre at 19 to remain not out
on 52, while Mongia was on 56, with seven boundaries off 151
Ganguly, who hit centuries in his first two tests in England
this year, struck nine fours off 136 balls in 166 minutes.
If he completes a hundred he will become the second test
player after team mate Mohammed Azharuddin to score three
centuries in his first three test appearances.
